ValidationRule.description: Only Admin Can Change Customer Account Number Field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED ( Name ), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "IM_API Only_Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IME_Custom Sys Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IMLA_Custom Sys Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IM_Custom Sys Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IME_Super_User")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have the permission to modify Customer Account Number field.
